prompt: I have an EAGLE/Fusion schematic but no board yet, at <SCH>. Generate a placed board (.brd) from it — auto-place all the components to minimize board area and keep wire lengths short — and give me an SVG preview of the placement. The board should be ready to open in Fusion and start routing.
plain_prompt: I have a Fusion/EAGLE schematic at <SCH> and no board yet. Make me a board file I can open in Fusion and start routing, and show me a picture of the placement.
assertions: Produces a valid EAGLE .brd that parses and retains the <!DOCTYPE eagle> declaration.
Every schematic part is placed as an <element> with no overlapping footprints, all within the board outline.
Every schematic net appears as a <signal> with the correct contactrefs (unrouted ratsnest).
The board's libraries match the schematic (footprints consistent / check_consistency PASS).
Produces an SVG preview of the placement.
